headline: Stock market during the day August 28 – BUX in freefall, shares seek direction, Mol in positive territory
summary: The BUX on the Budapest Stock Exchange fell further after the opening, standing at 148,982.62 points around noon. OTP and Mol were among the traded shares mentioned in the report.
why: The BUX is the benchmark index of the Budapest Stock Exchange, tracking major Hungarian companies such as OTP and MOL.
